description: For one regime slug (from list_tax_regimes) and one 6-digit ISTAT code (from search_comuni): qualifies, does_not_qualify or not_assessable, with a one-sentence reason to quote. not_assessable is never a no. This is about the place only; say so, and never present it as whether a person qualifies or as tax advice.

comune.description: 6-digit ISTAT comune code. Find it with /comuni?q=.

name: check_tax_eligibility

license.description: License of Expat Living Italy's own work only; upstream data keeps its own license, per dataset.

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

geographicEligibility.description: qualifies: the comune meets the regime's verified geographic criteria. does_not_qualify: it doesn't, and the rule has no unverified route that could admit it. not_assessable: no geographic answer can be given (see reason).

headroom.description: Residents between this comune and the ceiling, when it qualifies.

page.description: This comune's profile page on expatliving.it — link it when you quote any figure below.

slug.description: Stable URL slug for /data/comune/{slug} — never changes, even if a comune merges.

coverage.description: How many of Italy's places this dataset covers at all, e.g. 7587 of 7894 comuni.

extractedOn.description: ISO date this value was extracted from the source.

method.description: URL to the methodology page for this dataset.

reason.description: Present only when value is null: why this place has no figure.

vintage.description: The period the value describes, e.g. "2025H2" or "2025" — not when it was fetched.

reason.description: One sentence on why, safe to quote.

criteria.description: geographic: some comuni qualify and others don't. person: turns on who you are, not where you live; no per-comune answer exists.

status.description: draft: encoded but not yet checked against the legislation. A draft regime's eligibility is never served.

title: Does a comune meet a regime's geographic criteria?
